verdict.rationale: Orama's open-source library runs fully in-process/keyless with no server calls (orama-probe-rt-1), letting a developer create, insert, and search against local test data entirely separate from any production Orama Cloud project, and the docs note that projects/data sources can be split so different data sets are isolated (orama-docs-22, orama-docs-11). However, there is no explicit 'sandbox environment' or staging-mode feature documented for Orama Cloud itself; it's a workaround via local OSS usage rather than a first-class sandbox. Missing for 10: an official Orama Cloud sandbox/staging project mode, docs explicitly framing this as safe pre-production testing.
